observations: Photos show a sewing machine stand/table with a black metal frame and two long wooden work surfaces.
There is a rectangular cut-out in the tabletop (where a sewing machine would sit).
A foot pedal/lever mechanism is visible on the right side of the frame.
No sewing machine head/motor is visible in the photos—only the stand/legs and related frame parts.

claims.evidence: Photos show a sewing machine stand/legs/frame.
No visible brand/label/markings on the stand in the photos.
No motor or sewing machine head is shown in the provided photos.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories or manual are shown in the photos.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service history or proof is shown; motor/sewing head not visible.

risks.risk: The listing may not include the sewing machine/motor—photos only show the stand/legs. If you buy expecting a working machine, you may receive only furniture/frame.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the full sewing machine head/motor installed on the stand (or separate photos of the motor and machine head with model/serial).
risks.if_unproven: Price as stand/legs only (not a working machine).

risks.risk: Japanese-made claim cannot be verified; could be generic/unknown origin, affecting value.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of any brand plate/engraving/serial number on the stand or machine head.

risks.risk: Condition/straightness and any rust/wobble are not fully assessable from these angles; damage could reduce usability.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the stand on the ground (wobble check) and the pedal/lever movement.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for used condition (assume needs basic cleaning/adjustment).

risks.risk: Accessories/manual may be missing even if claimed.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the full set laid out (manual pages cover + all accessories).

proof_requests: Send a photo of the sewing machine head/motor (or confirm it’s not included) and show how it fits on this stand.
Close-up of any brand plate/engraving/serial number (stand and/or machine head).
Video: stand placed on flat ground showing stability + pedal/lever movement.
Photos of all claimed accessories and the original manual (manual cover + contents).
response.reason: The photos clearly show a sewing machine stand/legs, but the seller’s key claims about a Japanese motor running smoothly and including accessories/manual are not verifiable because the motor/machine head and accessories are not shown.
